response:
Diagnosis of gen 7 — the decisive new fact is that the **bearish repair worked**: Acquired Growth Without Organic Innovation (goodwill intensity + dilution + absence of a persistent R&D program) delivered FMB -4.83, α -3.7% (t=-3.17) and the archive's largest absolute Sharpe (-0.53). That means the organic-versus-acquired distinction is a *priced, factor-orthogonal* dimension that the long-side composites have never used. Meanwhile the long side has plateaued around α 4.4–5.3%: the margin channel raises FMB/Sharpe but its alpha contribution is partly absorbed because gross profitability overlaps FF5's RMW, whereas leverage-type channels (not spanned as cleanly) raise alpha. Gen 8 therefore does two things: it imports the goodwill/organic-composition axis into the long composite (a channel that is bearish-informative and RMW-orthogonal), and it tests dropping the RMW-overlapping margin channel to see whether alpha rises.

---SIGNAL 1---
NAME: Organic Versus Acquired Innovation Balanced
EXPRESSION: SUMRANK(SUMRANK(TS_COUNT(xrd, 5), NEG(RATIO(COALESCE(gdwl, 0), at))), SUMRANK(RATIO(SUB(sale, cogs), at), NEG(GROWTH(csho, 1))))
HYPOTHESIS: Firms that grow intangible capital internally through a persistent R&D program, rather than by buying it and booking goodwill, and that fund it from margins without diluting shareholders, hold intangible capital acquired below fair value and are systematically underpriced.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: The organic-versus-acquired axis carried the archive's best short-side evidence (α -3.7%, Sharpe -0.53) yet has never entered a long composite, and it is economically the sharpest statement of the theme: innovation created versus innovation purchased with financing. Replacing the R&D-intensity slot with a goodwill penalty keeps the proven equal-weight four-channel architecture while adding a dimension the FF5 factors do not span.
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite

---SIGNAL 2---
NAME: Smoothed Organic Innovation Financing Composite
EXPRESSION: SUMRANK(SUMRANK(TS_COUNT(xrd, 5), MA(RATIO(COALESCE(xrd, 0), at), 3)), SUMRANK(MA(RATIO(SUB(sale, cogs), at), 3), SUMRANK(NEG(GROWTH(csho, 1)), NEG(RATIO(COALESCE(gdwl, 0), at)))))
HYPOTHESIS: The best available long signal combines a persistent and sizeable internal R&D program measured as a smoothed state, margin funding capacity, absence of dilution, and a clean balance sheet free of purchased intangibles.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: Smoothing the two fundamental states already improved alpha and Sharpe relative to single-year measurement (α 4.7%, SR 0.479), and the goodwill penalty adds the short-side information that was missing; both changes are additive rather than substitutive, so this is the natural consolidation candidate. Goodwill enters at 12.5% weight so it refines the ranking without letting acquisition accounting dominate portfolio membership.
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite

---SIGNAL 3---
NAME: Six-Channel Innovation Financing Quality
EXPRESSION: SUMRANK(SUMRANK(TS_COUNT(xrd, 5), MA(RATIO(COALESCE(xrd, 0), at), 3)), SUMRANK(SUMRANK(MA(RATIO(SUB(sale, cogs), at), 3), NEG(RATIO(COALESCE(gdwl, 0), at))), SUMRANK(NEG(GROWTH(csho, 1)), NEG(RATIO(ADD(dltt, dlc), at)))))
HYPOTHESIS: All six evidence channels identified as informative — innovation persistence, innovation scale, margin funding, absence of purchased intangibles, no dilution, and unused debt capacity — describe distinct reasons intangible financing is productive rather than opportunistic, and their equal-weight combination should dominate any subset.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: Leverage is the one channel that has repeatedly pushed alpha above 5% with t above 4, and goodwill is the one channel with proven factor-orthogonal short-side power; this is the first construction that includes both without starving the dilution channel of weight. If the six-channel version raises alpha while holding FMB near 5, it becomes the final recommended signal.
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite

---SIGNAL 4---
NAME: Parsimonious Organic Innovation Versus Dilution
EXPRESSION: SUMRANK(NEG(GROWTH(csho, 1)), SUMRANK(TS_COUNT(xrd, 5), NEG(RATIO(COALESCE(gdwl, 0), at))))
HYPOTHESIS: The pure financing-times-intangibles effect is that undiluted, organically innovating firms outperform diluting firms whose intangibles were purchased; profitability is a separate premium and including it may add cross-sectional fit without adding abnormal return.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: Gross margin overlaps FF5's profitability factor, which plausibly explains why margin-heavy composites cap out near 4.5% alpha while margin-free composites with leverage reach 5.3%; dropping it while keeping dilution at 50% weight (the configuration with the archive's best composite Sharpe, 0.528) isolates whether the margin channel is buying FMB fit at the cost of alpha. This also yields the most parsimonious three-channel expression of the theme, which matters for credibility.
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite

---SIGNAL 5---
NAME: Organic Share Of Intangible Capital
EXPRESSION: SUMRANK(RATIO(TS_SUM(COALESCE(xrd, 0), 5), ADD(TS_SUM(COALESCE(xrd, 0), 5), COALESCE(intan, 0))), SUMRANK(RATIO(SUB(sale, cogs), at), NEG(GROWTH(csho, 1))))
HYPOTHESIS: What matters is the composition of a firm's intangible capital, not its level: a high share of internally generated knowledge relative to total intangible capital means the assets were built at cost rather than bought at market prices, and such firms outperform when they are also margin-funded and undiluted.
EXPECTED_SIGN: negative
REASONING: This measures the organic-versus-purchased distinction as a bounded composition ratio rather than as two separately ranked levels, which removes the size and industry variation embedded in scaling by assets and cannot be dominated by either component. It is the structurally different way to encode the gen-7 discovery, and comparing it with signal 1 tells us whether composition or separate levels is the better encoding.
INTERACTION_TYPE: ratio

---SIGNAL 6---
NAME: Levered Stock-Financed Intangible Acquirers
EXPRESSION: SUMRANK(RATIO(COALESCE(gdwl, 0), at), SUMRANK(SUMRANK(GROWTH(csho, 1), RATIO(ADD(dltt, dlc), at)), NEG(TS_COUNT(xrd, 5))))
HYPOTHESIS: The worst configuration in the theme is a firm that has bought its intangible base using both new shares and borrowed money while running no internal innovation program: it faces impairment risk, fixed claims, and has no organic pipeline to replace the acquired assets.
EXPECTED_SIGN: negative
REASONING: The gen-7 bearish signal achieved α -3.7% with Sharpe -0.53 using goodwill, dilution and the absence of R&D; adding the debt-financing channel completes the "both financing sources used to buy intangibles" story and should deepen the alpha, since leverage has independently produced reliable negative alphas in this setting. Keeping the additive rank structure avoids the zero-mass gating that produced degenerate portfolios in gen 4.
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite
